contests.title: City of Crowley -- 1/2 of 1% S&U - Mayor & BOA - 15 Yrs.
contests.summary:
City of Crowley Proposition
(One-half of One Percent (1/2 of 1%) Sales and Use Tax)
(City Infrastructure & Capital Improvements)

Summary:  One-half of one percent (1/2 of 1%) 15-year sales and use tax for acquiring, constructing, maintaining and improving infrastructure and capital improvements within the City, with the proceeds of the Tax to be subject to funding into bonds.

contests.title: Cons. School District No. 10 -- 20 Mills - SB - 10 Yrs.
contests.summary:
Consolidated School District No. 10 Proposition
(Tax Continuation)

Summary:  10 year, 20 mills tax continuation for the purpose of giving additional aid and support to public elementary and secondary schools in Consolidated School District No. 10 by providing funds for construction, repairs, purchase of equipment and/or supplies and additional improvements.
